1amandas-agony_2400x1265_crop_center.title: Haunted Graveyard Night
1amandas-agony_2400x1265_crop_center.description: A wide, dark, and eerie nighttime shot of a graveyard with a dilapidated, gothic-style house in the background. The sky is a deep teal-green, filled with countless bright white stars. In the foreground, to the left, stands a large, ornate stone cross and a weathered tombstone. Bare, skeletal trees are scattered throughout the scene, their branches reaching towards the starry sky. A metal fence runs across the midground, separating the graveyard from the distant, faintly lit horizon.

Churches - 1 of 17.title: Shadow of Christ Cathedral
Churches - 1 of 17.description: A dramatic nighttime view of the St. Louis Cathedral in New Orleans, featuring a large shadow of a figure with outstretched arms projected onto its white facade. In the foreground, a brightly illuminated white statue of Jesus with open arms stands on a pedestal, surrounded by dark trees and a tall stone monument. The scene is set under a dark, cloudy sky, with other historic buildings visible to the right.

Churches - 10 of 17.title: Church Under Stars
Churches - 10 of 17.description: A white church with a dark green steeple stands on a grassy hill under a vast, dark blue night sky filled with countless bright stars. A faint, wispy cloud formation is visible near the horizon on the left, and a few prominent stars or planets appear as streaks due to long exposure, particularly one bright streak in the upper left and another near the top center.

Churches - 11 of 17.title: Church Under Stars
Churches - 11 of 17.description: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a stone church with a white steeple and cross under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church is illuminated by a warm light, casting shadows on the surrounding dark ground and a wooden picket fence in the foreground. To the right, a large, bare tree trunk with branches extends into the upper right corner, and a small house with a white picket fence is visible behind the church.

Churches - 12 of 17.title: Abandoned Church Night Sky
Churches - 12 of 17.description: An old, weathered wooden church stands under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church has a tall, square bell tower and a front entrance with steps and a handrail. The wooden siding is faded and worn, with some areas appearing lighter than others due to light exposure. In the distance, on the left, there's a faint glow of light pollution, and on the right, a cluster of bright red lights is visible against the dark horizon.

Churches - 13 of 17.title: Abandoned Church Night
Churches - 13 of 17.description: An old, dilapidated church stands under a starry night sky. The church's facade is weathered, with peeling plaster revealing the underlying structure. Red light emanates from its windows and open doorway, casting an eerie glow. The church is surrounded by sandy ground with sparse dry grass and a few pieces of driftwood, with dark hills rising in the background on either side.

Churches - 14 of 17.title: Starry Night Church
Churches - 14 of 17.description: A small, reddish-brown stone church with a white door and a steeple topped with a white cross stands prominently under a vast, star-filled night sky. A narrow path leads from the foreground directly to the church's arched entrance, flanked by sparse, dark ground. The deep teal-blue sky above is densely populated with countless bright, twinkling stars, creating a serene and majestic atmosphere.

Churches - 15 of 17.title: Chaco Canyon Night Sky
Churches - 15 of 17.description: A long exposure photograph of the Pueblo Bonito ruins at Chaco Culture National Historical Park under a clear, star-filled night sky. The ancient stone walls are illuminated with a warm, orange light, highlighting their intricate construction and casting deep shadows. The dark blue sky above is densely populated with countless tiny white stars.

Churches - 16 of 17.title: Ruined Church Under Stars
Churches - 16 of 17.description: A wide-angle, low-light shot of a crumbling, light-colored church under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church's front entrance features a prominent red archway, and a cross is visible atop its bell tower. The right side of the sky is illuminated by an orange glow, likely from light pollution, while the left side reveals numerous stars. Bare branches and shrubs are visible in the foreground, lit by the same warm light illuminating the church.

Churches - 17 of 17.title: Red Doorway Stars
Churches - 17 of 17.description: A long-exposure photograph captures the ruins of a building at night, with a prominent central archway glowing red. Through the red-outlined doorway, dark mountains are visible, while the dark sky above is filled with numerous stars. A faint orange glow from distant light pollution illuminates clouds on the left horizon, adding to the mysterious and desolate atmosphere.

Churches - 2 of 17.title: First Presbyterian Church Night
Churches - 2 of 17.description: A grand, illuminated stone church at night, featuring a classical facade with four large fluted columns and ornate Corinthian capitals. Above the columns, the words 'FIRST PRESBYTERIAN CHURCH' are inscribed in gold letters. The central entrance has a large wooden double door with a stained glass transom depicting an angel, and above it, the inscription 'GOD IS LIGHT'. Flanking the entrance are two large arched windows with intricate stained glass, and two smaller stained glass windows are visible on the lower level, one on each side. The warm yellow light highlights the architectural details and the vibrant colors of the stained glass.

Churches - 3 of 17.title: Nin Churches Dusk
Churches - 3 of 17.description: A long exposure shot at dusk shows two stone buildings and a stone bridge over a river. On the left, a tall, slender bell tower with a pointed roof and arched openings is illuminated from within, casting a warm glow against the fading light. To the right, a smaller, single-story stone church with a red tile roof and a cross on its bell-gable stands on a grassy mound, surrounded by a pile of white rocks. The river flows under the arched bridge, its surface smoothed by the long exposure, reflecting the dim light of the sky.

Churches - 4 of 17.title: Fort Worth Skyline Night
Churches - 4 of 17.description: A nighttime cityscape features two tall, dark skyscrapers with numerous illuminated windows and red lights on their roofs, flanking a cluster of smaller buildings. In the foreground, a prominent white gothic-style church with multiple spires is brightly lit, surrounded by dark trees. Other buildings, including a light brown one and a pale green one with a parking garage, are also visible, all under a dark blue night sky.

Churches - 5 of 17.title: Night Lit Courtyard
Churches - 5 of 17.description: A nighttime photo of a building's courtyard, illuminated by various lights. The building on the left has large windows and a brick facade, with a tree in front whose leaves are brightly lit in yellow-green. Another tree to its right is adorned with purple string lights. The courtyard features stone benches and a patterned tiled ground, with shadows of trees cast across it. To the right, an arched walkway with columns leads further into the building's structure, with more trees and greenery visible.

Churches - 6 of 17.title: Illuminated Crosses Night Sky
Churches - 6 of 17.description: A large, brilliantly glowing white cross stands prominently on a dark, grassy hill under a deep blue, star-filled night sky. To its right, three smaller, darker crosses depicting crucified figures are visible, creating a dramatic and spiritual scene.

Churches - 7 of 17.title: Saint Olaf Church
Churches - 7 of 17.description: A historic, light-colored stone church with a dark shingled roof and a tall, ornate wooden steeple topped by a cross stands in a vast, dry field. A curving gravel path leads to its arched entrance, and a small cemetery gate is visible to the right, with distant rolling hills under a soft, overcast sky.

Churches - 8 of 17.title: Rural Church at Dusk
Churches - 8 of 17.description: A low-angle, wide shot of a small, white wooden church at dusk. The sky is a deep twilight blue with faint clouds. The church has a simple steeple with a white cross on top. The front door is open, revealing a warm, golden light emanating from within, illuminating an altar with a cross. Dark green trees frame the church on both sides, and a grassy field fills the foreground.

Churches - 9 of 17.title: Moonlit Desert Chapel
Churches - 9 of 17.description: A long exposure photograph of an old, dilapidated chapel at night, with a bright full moon directly behind the cross on its roof, creating a strong halo effect. Streaky clouds appear to radiate from the moon across the dark sky, which is dotted with faint stars. The chapel's stucco walls are peeling, revealing a mesh underneath, and its wooden doors and window frames are weathered. Dry grass and sand cover the ground in front of the building, with dark hills visible in the background.

night15.title: Moonlit Church and Ruin
night15.description: A long exposure photograph taken at night shows a dirt road leading towards a small, white church with a dome-shaped steeple, nestled among dark trees in the distance. To the left, a brick building heavily overgrown with dark green ivy and vines stands partially obscured by tall grass, its windows dark and empty. The sky above is a deep indigo, streaked with faint, wispy clouds and dotted with numerous stars, suggesting a moonlit night.

night206.title: Desert Night Church
night206.description: A nighttime photo shows a small, rustic stone church with a white picket fence on the left, and a dilapidated yellow adobe building with a corrugated metal roof on the right. The dark sky above is filled with countless bright stars, and a faint glow from the horizon suggests distant light pollution. The overall mood is serene and slightly melancholic, highlighting the quiet beauty of an abandoned or remote settlement under a starry sky.

night272.title: Milky Way Church Night
night272.description: A long exposure photograph captures a dimly lit brick church with a tall steeple and cross under a vast, star-filled night sky. The faint, cloudy band of the Milky Way stretches across the upper right, while countless stars appear as short trails across the dark expanse. A dark tree is partially visible on the left, and the church's windows glow faintly.
